The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) principles and experience in applying CFD tools to solve complex multiphase flow problems. He / She will be responsible for conducting CFD simulations to analyse and optimize fluid flow in a variety of industrial applications.

Conduct CFD simulations of multiphase flow problems using commercial CFD software, such as ANSYS Fluent or STARCCM+ Develop and validate CFD models for a variety of applications, including oil and gas, chemical, and power generation Analyze CFD results to identify and evaluate fluid flow patterns, pressure drops, and heat transfer characteristics Provide recommendations for design improvements based on CFD results Participate in the development of CFD methodologies and best practices Collaborate with engineers and scientists from other disciplines to solve complex engineering problems Prepare technical reports and presentations to document CFD results and findings Requirements: Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering with thesis work done in CFD modelling and simulation Strong understanding of multiphase flow theory and application Proficient in CFD software, such as ANSYS Fluent or STARCCM+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to work independently and as part of a team Benefits: Competitive salary and benefits package Opportunity to work on cutting-edge CFD projects Chance to make a significant impact on a variety of industrial applications Collaborative and supportive work environment
